lines.en: The water is shallow ahead; I can rest.
Mud slides off my back.

lines.zh: 四条腿在泥里，一步一沉。
lines.en: Four legs in the mud, sinking at each step.

lines.zh: 红树林的根，我一条条跨过去。
lines.en: I cross the mangrove roots one by one.

lines.zh: 尾巴在泥上拖出一道沟。
lines.en: My tail drags a groove through the mud.
I am in no hurry; neither is the swamp.
I go around that clump of mangrove roots.
I crawl slowly along the waterline.

lines.zh: 红树的影子里，我挪过去。
lines.en: I shift into the mangrove's shade.

lines.zh: 红树林的根，和我缠在一起。
lines.en: Mangrove roots tangle with mine.
I'm used to lying in swamp mud.

lines.zh: 我尾巴一甩，泥水溅你一身。
lines.en: One flick of my tail and mud's all over you.
The mangrove mud is warm and close.
I warm the venom in my mouth.

lines.zh: 红树的根缠着我的尾巴。
lines.en: Mangrove roots wrap around my tail.

lines.zh: 蚊子在我眼边绕，我不动。
lines.en: Mosquitoes circle my eyes; I don't move.

lines.zh: 红树影里，我连呼吸都省着。
lines.en: In the mangrove shade I even ration my breath.
An egret stands on my back.

lines.zh: 我泥里的根，正慢慢展开。
lines.en: The roots in my mud slowly spread.
Another layer of swamp mud.
The swamp blows its third bubble.

lines.zh: 又一片红树叶落进沼泽了。
lines.en: Another red leaf fell into the swamp.
I roll over in the mud, very slowly.
Soaking in mud, do not disturb.
This pose lasts until spring.

lines.zh: 沼泽的泥，裹住了我的爪。
lines.en: Swamp mud coats my claws.

lines.zh: 泥里那点动静，是我弄的。
lines.en: That stirring in the mud is me.
The water under the mud is cool.

lines.zh: 红树林的根，缠着我的背。
lines.en: Mangrove roots cling to my back.
The sun roasts my scaled back.
A gator's venom works slowly.
I open my mouth, and the poison comes first.

lines.zh: 你往泥里看，泥里也有我。
lines.en: You look into the mud; I am in it too.

lines.zh: 你踩的那块泥，是我的枕头。
lines.en: That patch of mud you tread is my pillow.
Two legs, standing so straight.
So you're the one Vile Gator mentioned.
Come here; let me measure your feet.

lines.zh: 沼泽里你的脚步我认得。
lines.en: I know your step in this swamp.
One of my eyes can see through you.
Your boots make me hungry.
What are you hesitating about on the bank?
The swamp's black water only reaches my back.
Under my scales, the blood is green.
My teeth are still here; I haven't lost.
The mud took part of the blow.

lines.zh: 疼得我把尾巴缩进泥里。
lines.en: It hurt so much I pulled my tail into the mud.

lines.zh: 这身鳞片替我挡了大半。
lines.en: These scales took most of it for me.
Who's breaking my branches?
I growl, and the mud trembles.

lines.zh: 沼泽的泥，藏住我整条尾巴。
lines.en: Swamp mud hides my whole tail.
That one bit my tail.
The blow swelled my poison sac.
My roots reach out on their own.

lines.zh: 你把东西放泥上，走远点。
lines.en: Set it on the mud and step back.
The swamp's rot is my favorite smell.

lines.zh: 我嘴边冒的气，你可别吸。
lines.en: Do not breathe the vapor by my jaws.
The smell drifted over on the water.

lines.zh: 沼泽的泥，糊住了我的眼睛。
lines.en: Swamp mud has gummed up my eyes.
I open my mouth; it's not to bite you.
Drop that meat down here.
I know the sound of mangrove shallows.
Give it to me, and I'll let you cross.

lines.zh: 我背上的鳞蹭了你一下。
lines.en: The scutes on my back scraped you.
Rolling over in the mire takes time.
A collision in the mud splashes everywhere.
You broke up the sun I was basking in.
Steady; the mud is slick.
My gator tail sweeps your legs out.
Your boots sink into my mud.
That one threw mud up into the trees.
Only my eyes show above the mud.
Mangrove mud is the perfect cover.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴绕住你的尾巴。
lines.en: My tail curls around yours.
The swamp water has warmed; come.
This season, my call is loudest.
The mud nest fits only us two.
Let us bask in this same sun.
Don't fear my teeth; I keep them sheathed.

lines.zh: 我背上的鳞，还挂着水草。
lines.en: Seagrass still hangs from my scales.
This season allows one love only.

lines.zh: 红树林的泥，我们各占一半。
lines.en: We each take half this mangrove mud.
Under the mangrove, I cleared a patch of mud.
This egg no longer belongs to you.

lines.zh: 我在泥里摸到一块骨头。
lines.en: I feel out a bone in the mud.
If it sinks, it's mine.

lines.zh: 红树林的泥，粘住我的尾巴。
lines.en: Mangrove mud clings to my tail.
It's mine now. Say no more.
A round stone by the marsh; I'll keep it.
I carry it into my mud nest with my teeth.

lines.zh: 这根骨头，能让花长得更旺。
lines.en: This bone will make the flowers grow.
This shield can line the mud.
Waterweed still holds it; I tear it free.
Mangrove roots have you wrapped.
The muck counts your steps.
My venomous teeth are aimed at your ankle.
Don't move; the mud remembers you.

lines.zh: 我抛人的时候，毒也跟着。
lines.en: When I toss you, the poison follows.

lines.zh: 沼泽里的树倒了，我记住了。
lines.en: A tree fell in the marsh — I remember.

lines.zh: 我把你抛起来，再等落地。
lines.en: I toss you up and wait for the landing.

lines.zh: 你身上的热气，先被闻到了。
lines.en: Your body heat was smelled first.
This dose of venom is for you.
The swamp takes, and never gives back.
Each step you take, the mud answers.

lines.zh: 泥底下只露出我的眼睛。
lines.en: Only my eyes show above the mud.

lines.zh: 红树林的根，绊住你的脚。
lines.en: Mangrove roots catch your feet.
The more you struggle, the tighter the mud.
There is no path for you along the bank.
I swim slowly, but I don't drift.
I lie low, showing only my eyes.
Footprints in the mud cool slowly.

lines.zh: 我把你抛上去，毒还在血里。
lines.en: I toss you up, and the venom stays.
The mangrove roots are closing in.
My venomous teeth close, and your blood numbs.
One bite from me poisons you.
Swamp rule: bite first, talk later.
I flip you up, then slam you down.
This bite goes for your calf.
I bite, then drag you into the mud.

lines.zh: 这一甩，练了几十个雨季。
lines.en: Years of wet seasons went into that swing.
That crunch was your bone.
The swamp mud is stickier than I am.
My tail whips out, mud flying with it.
Tail out of the mud first, then my head.

lines.zh: 沼泽的泥在冒泡，我醒了。
lines.en: The swamp mud bubbles; I am awake.
This smell is a new rainy season.

lines.zh: 红树林的泥在冒泡，我醒了。
lines.en: The mangrove mud bubbles — I'm awake.
The swamp rolls a bubble; I open my eyes.
My jaws open and poison mist spreads.

lines.zh: 这一口带毒，别说我没提醒。
lines.en: This bite is venomous — I did warn you.
After a long sleep, my teeth are still sharp.
I push up out of the mud.
I'll dry my back, then enter the water.
The mud got stuffy; I came out to look.
The mangrove roots made way.

lines.zh: 我在烧，快拍我背上的火。
lines.en: I am burning; slap the fire off my back.
Landed on hard ground — where's the mud?
I can hold my breath, but the water is too murky.

lines.zh: 炸起的泥糊住了我的眼。
lines.en: The blast threw mud into my eyes.
The arrow lodged between my scales.
My poison fangs close and you go up.

lines.zh: 饿得连泥里的虫都嫌少。
lines.en: So hungry even the mud-bugs seem too few.

lines.zh: 雷劈在红树上，烧到我背。
lines.en: Lightning struck the mangrove and burned down my back.
No mud to land on under the void.
